title: Postcard and Bakery
author: Gideon Brightwater
blurb: Petra Marchetti, a pastry chef whose café is three missed payments from gone, keeps love in the past tense where it belongs. Then the person behind a decade of letters moves in next door — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must forgive the person in the mirror first, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
